KUZ_COEFF = [148,32,133,16,194,192,1,251,
             1,192,194,16,133,32,148,1]

def kuz_constant(i):
    state = bytes(15) + bytes([i])
    for _ in range(16):
        feedback = 0
        for a, c in zip(state, KUZ_COEFF):
            feedback ^= gf_mul(a, c)
        state = bytes([feedback]) + state[:15]
    return state

print(kuz_constant(30).hex())
gf_mul реализует GF(2⁸) по x⁸ + x⁷ + x⁶ + x + 1; полная реализация — lab3.py.
